bindings.prompt: Original wuxia deckbuilding game asset, match attached card colour key for angular carved ink contour, three-value flat print, warm antique paper highlights; second reference for composition and economy of shapes. Exact straight-on orthographic view. No text, numbers, glyphs or watermarks. No detached shadows. A game asset atlas, wide landscape 3:2 canvas with exactly THREE separate tall Chinese thread-bound manuscript books equidistant on ONE horizontal line, centered at x 17%, 50%, 83%. Large generous transparent gutters. Complete uncut objects with identical proportions and size, same flat frontal view. A striking central wide plain midnight indigo cloth area for a large later printed emblem, leave upper and middle of cloth blank. Empty small antique title slip along left inside front cover, ochre cord along right edge. Left: master copy, immaculate smooth tight silk cover, neat parallel cord and crisp even folded cream paper edges. Middle: frequently handled woodblock copy, broken lower corner, visibly repaired strip of pale linen with three chunky hand stitches, one frayed cord loop, loose page corner peeking. Right: barely surviving ancient stitched fascicle; large diagonal lower third of front cloth missing exposing layered tan rag paper, torn uneven ragged silhouette, loose splayed pages bound with crooked red repair cord. emblems.prompt: Original wuxia deckbuilding game asset, match attached card colour key for angular carved ink contour, three-value flat print, warm antique paper highlights; second reference for composition and economy of shapes. Exact straight-on orthographic view. No text, numbers, glyphs or watermarks. No detached shadows. Create a square production atlas of 9 separate LARGE two-ink woodblock pictograms, in a precisely aligned 3 column by 3 row regular grid. Transparent ground, no enclosing disk, rectangle, frame, badge, lettering, decorative dots or shared grid lines. Each silhouette fills its own cell with 16% padding, perfectly separate. Each mark uses pale parchment body, a dark plum keyline, and ONE tiny vermilion accent. Chunky bold forms readable at 50px. Row1 left a single straight Chinese jian sword with unmistakable hilt, diagonal slant and trailing red tassel; row1 middle one soft cloth shoe in profile over a curved footprint wake; row1 right one closed fist in three-quarter view with cuff. Row2 left a chest cuirass with crossed protective sleeves; row2 middle a seated breathing figure with one curling wisp of breath; row2 right a fly-whisk with short grip and long sweeping hairs. Row3 left seven stars arranged as the Big Dipper linked by fine lines (formation); row3 middle a tied red silk bookmark knot; row3 right two complementary torn paper halves joining into one sheet. No gradients. Do not repeat motifs.

binding_extraction: Three horizontal cells. Crop alpha with threshold 48 and a four-pixel gutter. Keep the sound, worn and torn shells distinct. Jade and gold variants recolour only the indigo fabric.
emblem_extraction: Three by three grid, row-major: sword, step, palm, guard, breath, whisk, array, bookmark knot and joining leaves.
